class.name: SuperposRpc
class.brief_description: A registered typed RPC declaration of a schema.
class.description: Declared in [member SuperposSchema.rpcs]. The wire names an RPC only by its numeric ID and a target object handle; it never carries a method, script, resource or property name. Calls are authorized at execution: on the authority against the live World (declared RPC, payload bound, authority epoch and [member permission], with the current ownership revision for Owner calls), and on a client only for a Ready replica whose schema declares the RPC.

members.member: Largest accepted payload in bytes, 1 through 4096.
Who may call it: [constant PERMISSION_AUTHORITY] (only the authority), [constant PERMISSION_OWNER] (the current owner of the target object) or [constant PERMISSION_ADMITTED_PEER] (any admitted peer).
Nonzero unsigned RPC identifier, unique within its schema.

constants.constant: Only the authority may call this RPC.
Only the current owner of the target object may call this RPC.
Any admitted peer may call this RPC.
